```{r}
library(TCGAbiolinks)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
query <- GDCquery(
  project = "TCGA-BRCA",
  data.category = "Transcriptome Profiling",
  data.type = "Gene Expression Quantification",
  workflow.type = "STAR - Counts"
)
GDCdownload(query)
data <- GDCprepare(query)
```
```{r}

clinical_df <- as.data.frame(colData(data))


genes_df <- as.data.frame(rowData(data))



expression_df <- as.data.frame(assay(data))

```

```{r}
clinical_df_tumor <- clinical_df[clinical_df$sample_type == "Primary Tumor", ]

library(dplyr)
clinical_df_tumor <- clinical_df_tumor |>
  group_by(patient) |>
  arrange(desc(days_to_last_follow_up)) |>
  slice(1) |>
  ungroup()


sum(duplicated(clinical_df_tumor$patient))
nrow(clinical_df_tumor)


clinical_df_tumor$survival_group <- ifelse(
  clinical_df_tumor$vital_status == "Dead" & 
  clinical_df_tumor$follow_ups_disease_response == "WT-With Tumor",
  "Did Not Survive",
  ifelse(
    clinical_df_tumor$vital_status == "Alive" & 
    clinical_df_tumor$follow_ups_disease_response == "TF-Tumor Free",
    "Survived",
    "Unknown"
  )
)
```
```{r}

expr_matrix <- assay(data)  # raw counts



clinical_filtered <- clinical_df_tumor %>%
  filter(survival_group %in% c("Survived", "Did Not Survive"))


common_patients <- intersect(colnames(expr_matrix), clinical_filtered$barcode)
expr_filtered <- expr_matrix[, common_patients]
clinical_filtered <- clinical_filtered[match(common_patients, clinical_filtered$barcode), ]

```


```{r}

library(DESeq2)


dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = expr_filtered,
  colData = clinical_filtered,
  design = ~ survival_group
)


keep <- rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >= 10
dds <- dds[keep, ]


dds$survival_group <- relevel(dds$survival_group, ref = "Did Not Survive")


dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds, contrast = c("survival_group", "Survived", "Did Not Survive"))
res_df <- as.data.frame(res) %>% arrange(padj)
head(res_df, 10)
```

```{r}
normalized_counts <- counts(dds, normalized = TRUE)


survivor_counts    <- normalized_counts[, dds$survival_group == "Survived"]
nonsurvivor_counts <- normalized_counts[, dds$survival_group == "Did Not Survive"]


mean_survivors    <- rowMeans(survivor_counts)
mean_nonsurvivors <- rowMeans(nonsurvivor_counts)



alpha_survivors <- apply(survivor_counts, 1, function(x) {
  m <- mean(x)
  v <- var(x)
  if (m == 0) NA_real_ else (v - m) / m^2
})

alpha_nonsurvivors <- apply(nonsurvivor_counts, 1, function(x) {
  m <- mean(x)
  v <- var(x)
  if (m == 0) NA_real_ else (v - m) / m^2
})


disp_raw <- mcols(dds)$dispGeneEst 
disp_shrunken <- dispersions(dds)

nb_var_survivors    <- mean_survivors + alpha_survivors * mean_survivors^2
nb_var_nonsurvivors <- mean_nonsurvivors + alpha_nonsurvivors * mean_nonsurvivors^2

log2FC <- log2(mean_survivors / mean_nonsurvivors)

n1 <- ncol(survivor_counts)
n2 <- ncol(nonsurvivor_counts)

se_log2FC <- sqrt(
  (nb_var_survivors / (n1 * mean_survivors^2)) +
  (nb_var_nonsurvivors / (n2 * mean_nonsurvivors^2))
) / log(2)


z_approx <- log2FC / se_log2FC

pval_approx <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(z_approx))

padj_approx <- p.adjust(pval_approx, method = "BH")

# Put into a dataframe
mean_var_df <- data.frame(
  gene                      = rownames(normalized_counts),
  mean_survivors            = mean_survivors,
  mean_nonsurvivors         = mean_nonsurvivors,
  #alpha_survivors = alpha_survivors,
  #alpha_nonsurvivors = alpha_nonsurvivors,
  nb_var_survivors = nb_var_survivors,
  nb_var_nonsurvivors = nb_var_nonsurvivors,
 # DESeqdisp_raw = disp_raw,
  #DESeqdisp_shrunken = disp_shrunken,
  #se_log2FC = se_log2FC,
  z_approx = z_approx,
  pval_approx               = pval_approx#,
#  padj_approx               = padj_approx
)





mean_var_df <- mean_var_df %>%
  arrange(padj_approx)
head(mean_var_df)
```

```{r}

  normalized_counts <- counts(dds, normalized = TRUE)

# Extract that one gene
gene_counts <- normalized_counts["ENSG00000134827.8", ]

gene_df <- data.frame(
  counts         = gene_counts,
  log_counts     = log2(gene_counts + 1),
  survival_group = dds$survival_group
)


ggplot(gene_df, aes(x = log_counts, fill = survival_group)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of ENSG00000134827.8 Expression (log2)",
    x     = "log2(Normalized Counts + 1)",
    y     = "Density",
    fill  = "Survival Group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  geom_vline(
    data = gene_df %>% group_by(survival_group) %>% 
           summarise(mean = mean(log_counts)),
    aes(xintercept = mean, color = survival_group),
    linetype = "dashed",
    size = 1
  )
```


This will show you the duplicated patients sorted alphabetically so you can clearly see each patient appearing twice with their different sample types side by side like:
```
TCGA-XX-XXXX    Primary Tumor
TCGA-XX-XXXX    Solid Tissue Normal
TCGA-YY-YYYY    Primary Tumor
TCGA-YY-YYYY    Solid Tissue Normal
```



```{r}
gene_id <- "ENSG00000134827.8"


m1 <- mean_survivors[gene_id]
m2 <- mean_nonsurvivors[gene_id]
nb_v1 <- nb_var_survivors[gene_id]
nb_v2 <- nb_var_nonsurvivors[gene_id]


log2FC <- log2(m1 / m2)


var_log2_s  <- nb_v1  / (m1^2 * log(2)^2)
var_log2_ns <- nb_v2  / (m2^2 * log(2)^2)


pooled_sd <- sqrt((var_log2_s + var_log2_ns) / 2)



power.t.test(
  n           = (2 / (1 / n1 + 1 / n2)),
  delta       = abs(log2FC),
  sd          = pooled_sd,
  sig.level   = 0.05,
  type        = "two.sample",
  alternative = "two.sided"
)


power.t.test(
  n           = NULL,
  delta       = abs(log2FC),
  sd          = pooled_sd,
  sig.level   = 0.05,
  power       = 0.99,
  type        = "two.sample",
  alternative = "two.sided"
)
```
